description: Drafts short, decision-ready emails to executives, boards, and senior stakeholders, and helps executives write their own: leads with the bottom line, makes the ask and deadline explicit, compresses background to what the reader needs to decide, offers options with a recommendation, and handles bad news, escalations, approvals, and status updates with the right tone. Use when the user needs to write to a senior leader, request a decision or approval, escalate a problem, give an executive update, deliver bad news upward, or tighten a long email for a busy reader.
